design_freedom_level: High Density Dashboard & Live Call Tool

theme_strategy.rationale: Live video call co-pilots are positioned alongside Zoom/Meet windows or on secondary monitors. Dark mode with ultra-high contrast text and glowing tactical accent indicators reduces visual glare, fatigue, and distraction while maintaining instantaneous glanceability.

font_rules: Banned for headers: generic unstyled Inter, space grotesk
Headings must use uppercase micro-eyebrows with generous letter spacing (tracking-widest)
Speaker transcripts must use clear visual distinction: Host text in cool slate, Guest text in warm amber/emerald highlight
Question cards require large prompt text (text-lg to text-xl, font-medium) for quick reading at 2 feet distance

colors.gradient_forbidden: No full-screen gradients. Limit gradients to subtle 1px glows or backdrop blurs.

layout_architecture.mode: Side-by-Side Dual Pane Command Center (Glanceable UI)
layout_architecture.grid_structure: grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-4 p-4 md:p-6 min-h-screen

panels.header_toolbar: Top status bar: Audio input indicators (Mic + System/Tab Audio), Interviewer profile, Live duration counter, Quick preset switcher, Compact/Expanded view toggle.
panels.left_column: lg:col-span-5 - Live Setup & Speaker Transcript Stream. Contains Guest Card, Audio visualizers for Host & Guest, and auto-scrolling live transcript feed.
panels.right_column: lg:col-span-7 - Real-Time AI Suggestion Engine & Pinned Shortlist. Features live updating suggested follow-up questions categorized by topic/depth, with one-click pin & copy actions.

layout_architecture.compact_responsive_strategy: When squeezed into a narrow side window (< 768px), switch to a tabbed or vertical stacked layout so the host can overlay it next to Google Meet or Zoom.

key_features_to_implement.name: Interview Setup & Context Dock
key_features_to_implement.description: Form input for Guest Name, Role, Company, Topic, and a large rich notes area for background research (e.g., past talks, resume highlights, press articles).

key_features_to_implement.name: Dual Audio Capture Simulation & Live Status
key_features_to_implement.description: Start/Stop listening toggle with web audio API simulation for Host mic + Guest tab audio, active waveform visualizer bar, and real-time noise threshold stats.

key_features_to_implement.name: Live Two-Speaker Transcript Feed
key_features_to_implement.description: Real-time scrolling log distinguishing Host vs Guest utterances with timestamps, confidence scores, key topic badges, and pause detection triggers.

key_features_to_implement.name: Auto-Refreshing AI Follow-Up Generator
key_features_to_implement.description: Suggested questions generated instantly upon guest pause. Tagged by type (e.g., 'Deeper Probe', 'Challenging Counterpoint', 'Pivot Topic', 'Clarification').

key_features_to_implement.name: Question Shortlist & Pinning System
key_features_to_implement.description: Pin questions with hotkey or button click. Reorder pinned list, mark questions as 'Asked', copy to clipboard with instant toast notification.

key_features_to_implement.name: Custom Prompt Tuning & Focus Filters
key_features_to_implement.description: Quick filters to tilt AI suggestions towards technical details, personal stories, controversial takes, or timeline questions.

components_and_libraries.ui_primitives: Shadcn/UI JS components (Dialog, Tabs, Badge, Button, Input, Textarea, Tooltip, Switch, ScrollArea, DropdownMenu)
components_and_libraries.icons: lucide-react (Mic, MicOff, Volume2, Pin, PinOff, Copy, Check, Sparkles, User, AudioWaveform, Sliders, Settings, Play, Pause, RefreshCw, Zap, Bookmark)
components_and_libraries.notifications: sonner (for instant toast feedback when questions are copied or pinned)
components_and_libraries.motion: framer-motion for smooth entrance of new transcript lines and live AI question cards popping into view

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_convention: kebab-case, role-based identifiers on all buttons, audio triggers, transcript items, and pinned list elements.
testing_and_accessibility.contrast_standard: APCA 4.5:1 minimum on all text against background cards. Never rely solely on color; include icons and text badges.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a single-page React app (using .js files) tailored specifically for live interviewers and podcasters.
Implement realistic live simulated microphone and system audio capture states with animated SVG waveform equalizer bars.

Provide demo presets (e.g., 'Tech Founder Deep Dive', 'AI Ethics Debate', 'Investigative Podcast') so the user can test instant live transcripts and automatic follow-up question generation without needing a live mic.
Ensure every AI suggestion card has quick-action buttons: Pin (adds to sticky shortlist), Copy, Mark as Asked, and Rate usefulness.
Include a side-window compact mode toggle to allow using the app in a narrow split-screen window beside video conferencing apps.
Strictly follow code organization with clear modular components inside src/components/.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use generic centered layouts or unstyled default Inter headings.
Include hover and active state transitions on every button and card.
Use sonner for notifications when pinning or copying items.
Ensure all interactive elements carry data-testid attributes.
